questions.stem_text: A minimum wage in the market for fast-food workers is likely to produce

options.A: an increase in the demand for fast-food workers.
options.B: a decrease in the supply of fast-food workers.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a surplus of fast-food workers.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is not a scarce economic resource?
Which of the following is correct about the demand for labor?

options.A: The demand for labor is independent of the demand for other inputs or resources.
options.B: The demand for labor is independent of the demand for the products produced by labor.
options.C: The demand for labor is independent of the availability of other inputs or resources.
options.D: The demand for labor is derived from the demand for the products produced by labor.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - The demand for labor is derived from the demand for the products produced by labor.
